arguments.command:
set -eu
root=/home/storage/781/4477781/user
receiver=$root/webapp/bin/delegate-cagent
task=cagent-seed-e2e-$(date +%Y%m%dT%H%M%S)
deadline=$(($(date +%s)+240))
env=/tmp/$task.json
r1=/tmp/$task.r1.json
r2=/tmp/$task.r2.json
cat > "$env" <<EOF
{"task_id":"$task","origin_runtime_identity":"chatgpt:cagent-seed-e2e","target_agent_identity":"continuity-agent","objective":"Run bounded runtime health.","evidence_refs":["acceptance:cagent-seeded-admission"],"authority_ceiling":"read_only","allowed_capability_profile":["runtime_health"],"resource_budget":{"model_calls":1,"local_mcp_calls":1,"wall_seconds":90},"deadline":$deadline,"expected_result_schema":"assistant-delegation-receipt-v1","return_route":"stdout","requested_action":{"tool":"runtime_health","arguments":{}},"delegation_depth":0}
EOF
"$receiver" --input "$env" > "$r1"
key=$(printf '%s' "$task"|sha256sum|awk '{print $1}')
record=$root/.continuity-delegation/records/$key.json
m1=$(stat -c %Y "$record")
s1=$(sha256sum "$r1"|awk '{print $1}')
"$receiver" --input "$env" > "$r2"
m2=$(stat -c %Y "$record")
s2=$(sha256sum "$r2"|awk '{print $1}')
test "$s1" = "$s2"
test "$m1" = "$m2"
echo IDENTICAL_REPLAY_WITHOUT_REEXECUTION=PASS
echo TASK_ID=$task
echo RECEIPT_SHA256=$s2
cat "$r1"
rm -f "$env" "$r1" "$r2"
